about: A hypothetical program framed for a product operations take-home in April 2026, built on public news about lunar surface power. The program status, problems, suppliers and people are made up.

reg.gate: Part 52 design input, heat pipe shielding geometry
Category II transit shielding input to the NRC

events.label: The titanium mill slips another 3 weeks
The NRC asks for 12 kg more transit shielding

decisions.decision: Hold 10 kg of mass reserve against the Category II shielding risk. Only the program lead can release it.
why: The shielding requirement is the likeliest late mass add
A named reserve stops every team padding its own number

reopenIf.text: The NRC's shielding ask exceeds the 10 kg reserve

decisions.decision: Buy the heat pipe tubing from one qualified titanium mill. No second source yet.
why: Qualifying a second mill takes about six months
The tubing spec is already proven at this mill
decisions.rejected: Qualify a second mill before ordering

reopenIf.text: The mill slips more than 2 weeks

decisions.decision: Regulatory signs off on shielding geometry before each design maturity gate, not after.
why: A shielding finding after design freeze forces a redesign
It keeps NRC inputs ahead of the design, not behind it

reopenIf.text: Sign-off adds more than a week to any gate

decisions.decision: Keep the current radiator geometry and revisit at week 9.
why: Heat rejection margin for the 14-day lunar night is thin
There were 16 kg of headroom at week 6

reopenIf.text: A mass breach is projected within 6 weeks

decisions.decision: Cut 8 kg from the radiator geometry within what the current titanium tubing can do.
decisions.recommendation: Back the 8 kg cut. The 10 kg reserve is the insurance against the Category II shielding risk we still carry.

action.text: Publish the revised radiator design with the 8 kg reduction
action.closesWhen: The radiator row shows 8 kg less

decisions.decision: Issue the firm-fixed-price order to the primary titanium mill this quarter, and start qualifying a second mill in parallel.
decisions.recommendation: Lock the current lead time now. Do not trade schedule slack for supplier options at this stage.
decisions.rejected: Qualify a second mill before ordering

action.text: Issue the purchase order to the primary mill
action.closesWhen: The tubing lead time is locked in the matrix

decisions.decision: Agree the Category II transit shielding assumption with the NRC before the design input is due.
decisions.recommendation: Schedule the NRC engagement this month and carry a range, not a single number, until it is settled.
decisions.rejected: Submit the design input on today's assumption and fix it later
